experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form an $f0 dependency chain.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Three cases: 8 cycles when the dividend is 0, 10 cycles when the quotient is exact (a terminating binary fraction such as 1.0/2.0 or 1.5/1.0, where the divider stops early), and 16 cycles when the quotient needs the full 23-bit mantissa (1.0/3.0, or (1+2^-23)/1.0). The long case produces 4 quotient bits per cycle: 10 + 10+ceil(23/4). Measured with chains that hold both operands constant: divisor 1.0 makes the division exact, so `fdiv.s $f0, $f0, $f1` returns its own value, and a divisor chain started at 3.0 oscillates between two inexact quotients.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fdiv.s $f0, $f8, $f8; fdiv.s $f1, $f9, $f9; fdiv.s $f2, $f10, $f10; fdiv.s $f3, $f11, $f11; fdiv.s $f4, $f12, $f12; fdiv.s $f5, $f13, $f13; fdiv.s $f6, $f14, $f14; fdiv.s $f7, $f15, $f15
throughput.init: li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4' --asm 'fdiv.s $f0, $f8, $f8; fdiv.s $f1, $f9, $f9; fdiv.s $f2, $f10, $f10; fdiv.s $f3, $f11, $f11; fdiv.s $f4, $f12, $f12; fdiv.s $f5, $f13, $f13; fdiv.s $f6, $f14, $f14; fdiv.s $f7, $f15, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent. 8 independent lanes. CPI over operand values: ~1.5 for inf/NaN fast path, ~2.0 for exact quotients such as 1/1, ~3.5 for general/subnormal cases. CPI is unchanged for 1-20 independent lanes, so throughput is initiation-interval bound rather than latency bound.

notes: Latency and throughput are data-dependent. The latency range was re-measured with unroll=100000; unroll=1000 produced values about 0.2 cycles lower because the per-call overhead was not fully amortised. Throughput is initiation-interval bound: CPI is unchanged from 1 to 20 independent lanes, and mixed fast/slow lanes are additive.
